Last week's AirPods Pro 3 deal at nearly 25% off is still live and probably won't last. We're also tracking matte black Beats Solo Buds down to $41. But today's lead 9to5Toys Lunch Break story is on the Apple Certified Refurbished Store with the lowest-price M5 MacBook Pro down $300, alongside $100 off the brand new Apple Watch Series 11, plus rare discounts on Apple Sport Bands and Loops. Then we're showcasing historical lows on Anker's latest 3-in-1 Qi2 25W foldable MagSafe charging stand and 45W Nano Smart Display Charger, alongside Best Buy's updated Back to School sale. Hit the jump for all the details.

Amazon's nearly 25% off AirPods Pro 3 deal still live, could go up at any time

Last week's Apple shopping event offered one of the best deals we have ever tracked on AirPods Pro 3. The deal over at Best Buy, which also had Pro 3 discounts, has now ended and been updated with its 2026 Back to School sale, but Amazon's nearly 25% off AirPods Pro 3 deal is still going... for now.

Amazon is still shipping the latest Apple AirPods Pro 3 at $189.99 right now.

Down from $249, this nearly 25% off deal comes in around $10 below the Black Friday in July pricing and is among the lowest prices we have tracked since launch.

Best Buy's price has already risen back up to $200 earlier this morning. Recent history shows this price shift tends to foreshadow Amazon's pricing trajectory, meaning the extra discount you can find at Amazon could go back up at any moment — if you're still hoping to score a pair this week, this is your best shot. Amazon brought the price back up to match Best Buy at some point earlier this morning, which comes as no surprise.

We've only seen it go lower than this twice, both being very short-lived discounts — one in February at $184, and one more recently during the June Prime Day sale. Both deals have since expired, and chances are we won't see a better price until the fall sale season, during which Apple is expected to debut the next-generation model next month, possibly with a camera addition, and potentially at a higher price point.

  • AirPods Pro 3 $190 (orig. $249)
  • AirPods Max 2 $449 (orig. $549)
  • AirPods 4 $99 (orig. $129)
  • AirPods 4 with ANC $119 (orig. $179 new) — Renewed Premium

Apple Certified Refurbished Store now has lowest-price M5 MacBook Pro down $300

While we're still tracking up to $500 off the 2TB M5 Pro MacBook Pro, deals on the lowest-priced M5 model have been quite hard to come by. However, the Apple Certified Refurbished Store is now offering $300 off the lowest-priced M5 MacBook Pro it has in stock (the 16GB/1TB configuration).

The Apple Certified Refurbished Store is now shipping the 14-inch M5 MacBook Pro with 16GB RAM and 1TB SSD for $1,699.

Normally $1,999 brand new, you can grab it directly from Apple right now, backed by a full 1-year Apple warranty, for $300 under MSRP.

Further underscoring that point, for comparison, Amazon currently has this model listed at $1,849 new. Since the late-June price hike officially went into effect at major retailers, it hasn't gone for less than this at Amazon.

While it is a refurbished unit, we're talking about the best source for buying refurbished MacBooks and one of the lowest prices you can find online from a reputable seller for the lowest-price M5 MacBook Pro (the newest version available from Apple).

Anker's latest 3-in-1 Qi2 25W foldable MagSafe charging stand back at Prime Day low (35% off)

After getting hands-on time with it earlier this year, Anker's 25W 3-in-1 Prime foldable MagSafe charger has become a daily carry, travel, and home charging setup staple of mine. Now at nearly 35% off, we're getting a shot at scoring one again at the lowest price we have tracked on Amazon.

Anker's official Amazon store is now shipping its latest 25W 3-in-1 Prime foldable MagSafe charger for $99.97.

Normally $150, this 3-in-1 charging setup features 25W MagSafe top output and is nearly 35% off in either the Phantom Gray/Black or Radiant White colorways.

This week's deal matches the previous mention, hitting the pricing levels we saw during Anker's summer sale and Prime Day earlier this year.

While small and portable, it does have some weight to it, allowing it to sit sturdily on your desk or nightstand, making it just as useful in your home workspace as it is on the go.

You can use the main MagSafe charging pad while folded up, but as soon as you unfold it and pull out the pop-out Apple Watch charger alongside a third Qi pad made for your AirPods, it can power your whole setup.

  • 3-in-1 foldable MagSafe charger with 25W Qi2
  • Active cooling "Cicada Wing" biomimetic airflow channel for "19dB whisper-quiet operation"
  • 25W output across three devices: iPhone, Apple Watch, AirPods
  • Qi2 certified with MagSafe-compatible magnetic alignment • Supports iPhone 17, 16, 15, and 14 series
  • iPhone: Up to 25W wireless charging
  • (3.74 × 2.38 × 1.22 inches), weighs same as iPhone 17 Pro Max (8.11 oz)
  • What you'll find in the box: Anker Prime Wireless Charging Station (3-in-1, MagGo, AirCool, foldable), 45W USB-C charger, 5-foot USB-C to USB-C cable, 2 anti-slip watch stickers, welcome guide, and 24-month warranty

Hit up my hands-on review for a closer look at all the details.

Lowest-priced Apple Watch Series 11 models down $100 again, from $299

Amazon has extended its AirPods Pro 3 summer discounts into August, and alongside historical lows on AirTag 2, is also once again taking $100 off most of the most popular (and lowest-priced) Apple Watch Series 11 models, starting from $299.

Amazon is once again taking $100 off all of the base GPS-only Apple Watch Series 11 models, with the 42mm model at $299 and the 46mm model at $329.

  • 42mm Apple Watch Series 11 $299 (orig. $399)
  • 46mm Apple Watch Series 11 $329 (orig. $429)

This is the deal we tracked during summer Prime Day, which has popped back up a few times in July, but you've got a chance to grab one today. At the time of writing, only the base GPS-only models are seeing notable discounts — the GPS + Cell models, while seeing some deals, aren't generally down low enough to recommend just yet.

Note that Amazon is having inventory issues on the base 42mm Jet Black, but it looks likely that they'll be back in stock at any moment — all 46mm colorways are in stock and down $100.

Anker's 2026 Back to School sale drops chargers, power banks, and Qi2.2 gear back to Prime Day lows from $10 (46% off)

Anker is now running a Back to School sale with the promo code SCHOOL20 for 20% off sitewide on chargers, power banks, cables, charging stations, and more. The brand's official Amazon storefront is also running comparable deals with some of its own extras thrown in, spanning popular models across the lineup. From small Nano chargers to multi-port laptop power supplies, MagSafe charging setups, power banks, and everyday accessories, there's something for everyone. Many Amazon deals are dropping prices back down to recent Prime Day historical lows, allowing you to once again score these at all-time best prices without waiting for the next big shopping event. Whether you're prepping a new school or work setup or just looking to refresh your charging gear, there are plenty of solid Anker deals to check out right now.

Anker's 2026 Back to School sale is now live

One standout deal from this sale drops Anker's latest 45W Nano USB-C charger with a smart display back down to $25.99 shipped. Normally $40, today's deal takes $16 off, hitting the historical low we saw during the recent Prime Day sale. That's 35% off, which beats the deals we've tracked directly from Anker. This is one of Anker's newer compact chargers, and all available colors are at the same $25.99 price. The built-in smart display can identify supported iPhone models, optimize charging for safer power delivery, and show useful charging info, along with some fun animations. It can deliver up to 45W output through a single USB-C port, and the foldable prongs keep it small for travel, tech bags, or everyday carry.
